name: arkova-api-cli
description: JSON command-line client for the Arkova verification API

scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix ../sdk run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsup src/cli.ts --format esm --platform node --target es2022 --no-splitting
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint

author: Arkova <engineering@arkova.ai>
